\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ} (teppa)}{ತೆಪ್ಪ (teppa)}]{\kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ} (teppa) — a coracle; a raft}

\label{lesson:KA-C454-teppa}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a compass, then the Kannada for an ocean.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ}}
\textbf{\kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ}} — \emph{teppa} — \textquotedblleft{}a coracle; a raft\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ನಾವು} \kn{ತೆಪ್ಪದಲ್ಲಿ} \kn{ನದಿಯನ್ನು} \kn{ದಾಟಿದೆವು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nāvu teppadalli nadiyannu dāṭidevu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We crossed the river in a coracle.
\end{quote}

A round basket boat, still used for river crossings.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ}} (\emph{teppa}) is native Dravidian: DEDR 3414 lists Kannada \emph{teppa}, \textquotedblleft{}a raft, a float\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{teppa}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{teppa}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nāvu teppadalli nadiyannu dāṭidevu.} — We crossed the river in a coracle.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for a compass, then the Kannada for an ocean, then say \emph{teppa} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A coracle; a raft\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ} (ambiga)}{ಅಂಬಿಗ (ambiga)}]{\kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ} (ambiga) — a ferryman; a boatman}

\label{lesson:KA-C454-ambiga}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for an ocean, then the Kannada for a coracle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ}} — \emph{ambiga} — \textquotedblleft{}a ferryman; a boatman\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ} \kn{ತೆಪ್ಪವನ್ನು} \kn{ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ} \kn{ನಡೆಸಿದನು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ambiga teppavannu nidhānavāgi naḍesidanu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The ferryman steered the coracle slowly.
\end{quote}

Plural: \kn{ಅಂಬಿಗರು}, \emph{ambigaru}.

\kn{ಅಂಬಿ} is an old word for a boat; -\kn{ಗ} marks the man who works it.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ}} (\emph{ambiga}) is native Dravidian: DEDR 177 lists Kannada \emph{ambi}, \textquotedblleft{}a boat\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{ambiga}, \textquotedblleft{}a man who rows a boat\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ambiga}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ambiga}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ambiga teppavannu nidhānavāgi naḍesidanu.} — The ferryman steered the coracle slowly.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for an ocean, then the Kannada for a coracle, then say \emph{ambiga} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A ferryman; a boatman\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ತೀರ} (tīra)}{ತೀರ (tīra)}]{\kn{ತೀರ} (tīra) — a shore; a bank}

\label{lesson:KA-C454-tira}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a coracle, then the Kannada for a ferryman.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ತೀರ}}
\textbf{\kn{ತೀರ}} — \emph{tīra} — \textquotedblleft{}a shore; a bank\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ} \kn{ಆಚೆಯ} \kn{ತೀರ} \kn{ತಲುಪಿತು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{teppa āceya tīra talupitu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The coracle reached the far bank.
\end{quote}

\kn{ಕಡಲತೀರ}, a beach, is the shore of the sea.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ತೀರ}} (\emph{tīra}) is borrowed from Sanskrit \emph{tīra}, \textquotedblleft{}a shore, a bank\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 5842).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tīra}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tīra}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{teppa āceya tīra talupitu.} — The coracle reached the far bank.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for a coracle, then the Kannada for a ferryman, then say \emph{tīra} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ತೀರ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A shore; a bank\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಉಬ್ಬರ} (ubbara)}{ಉಬ್ಬರ (ubbara)}]{\kn{ಉಬ್ಬರ} (ubbara) — high tide; a surge}

\label{lesson:KA-C454-ubbara}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a ferryman, then the Kannada for a shore.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಉಬ್ಬರ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಉಬ್ಬರ}} — \emph{ubbara} — \textquotedblleft{}high tide; a surge\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಸಂಜೆ} \kn{ಉಬ್ಬರದಲ್ಲಿ} \kn{ಅಲೆಗಳು} \kn{ದಡದವರೆಗೆ} \kn{ಬಂದವು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sañje ubbaradalli alegaḷu daḍadavarege bandavu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
At high tide in the evening the waves came up to the bank.
\end{quote}

Its pair is \kn{ಇಳಿತ}, low tide.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಉಬ್ಬರ}} (\emph{ubbara}) is native Dravidian, built on \emph{ubbu}, \textquotedblleft{}to swell, to rise\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 666), the family that also names the rising flood tide.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ubbara}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ubbara}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sañje ubbaradalli alegaḷu daḍadavarege bandavu.} — At high tide in the evening the waves came up to the bank.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for a ferryman, then the Kannada for a shore, then say \emph{ubbara} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಉಬ್ಬರ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}High tide; a surge\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಸುಳಿ} (suḷi)}{ಸುಳಿ (suḷi)}]{\kn{ಸುಳಿ} (suḷi) — a whirlpool; an eddy}

\label{lesson:KA-C454-suli}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a shore, then the Kannada for high tide.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಸುಳಿ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಸುಳಿ}} — \emph{suḷi} — \textquotedblleft{}a whirlpool; an eddy\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ನದಿಯ} \kn{ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ} \kn{ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿ} \kn{ಸುಳಿ} \kn{ಇದೆ}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nadiya madhyadalli apāyakāri suḷi ide.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
There is a dangerous whirlpool in the middle of the river.
\end{quote}

\kn{ಸುಳಿಗಾಳಿ}, a whirlwind; \kn{ಸುಳಿ} also names the whorl of hair on the head.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಸುಳಿ}} (\emph{suḷi}) is native Dravidian: DEDR 2698 lists older Kannada \emph{suḻi}, \textquotedblleft{}to turn round; a whirl, a whirlpool, an eddy\textquotedblright{}, beside Tamil \emph{cuḻi}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{suḷi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{suḷi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nadiya madhyadalli apāyakāri suḷi ide.} — There is a dangerous whirlpool in the middle of the river.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for a shore, then the Kannada for high tide, then say \emph{suḷi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಸುಳಿ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A whirlpool; an eddy\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Filling the Tank to Crossing the River}

\label{lesson:KA-R454-review-448-454}



\begin{quote}
Say the Kannada for fuel and diesel.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item fuel, diesel, a fuel station, a battery, to ride
  \item a wheel, a tyre, a spare tyre, to get a puncture, a brake
  \item a mechanic, a garage, a spare part, to break down, repair work
  \item a lorry, a jeep, a taxi, a motorbike, a bullock cart
  \item transport, a depot, goods, to transport, a courier
  \item a ship, a sailor, an anchor, a compass, an ocean
  \item a coracle, a ferryman, a shore, high tide, a whirlpool
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Fuel? (\textbf{\kn{ಇಂಧನ}}, \emph{indhana}.) Diesel? (\textbf{\kn{ಡೀಸೆಲ್}}, \emph{ḍīsel}.) A fuel station? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಂಕ್}}, \emph{baṅk}.) A battery? (\textbf{\kn{ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ}}, \emph{byāṭari}.) To ride? (\textbf{\kn{ಸವಾರಿ} \kn{ಮಾಡು}}, \emph{savāri māḍu}.) A wheel? (\textbf{\kn{ಚಕ್ರ}}, \emph{cakra}.) A tyre? (\textbf{\kn{ಟಯರ್}}, \emph{ṭayar}.) A spare tyre? (\textbf{\kn{ಸ್ಟೆಪ್ನಿ}}, \emph{sṭepni}.) To get a puncture? (\textbf{\kn{ಪಂಕ್ಚರ್} \kn{ಆಗು}}, \emph{paṅkcar āgu}.) A brake? (\textbf{\kn{ಬ್ರೇಕ್}}, \emph{brēk}.) A mechanic? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೆಕ್ಯಾನಿಕ್}}, \emph{mekyānik}.) A garage? (\textbf{\kn{ಗ್ಯಾರೇಜ್}}, \emph{gyārēj}.) A spare part? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಿಡಿಭಾಗ}}, \emph{biḍibhāga}.) To break down? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೆಟ್ಟುಹೋಗು}}, \emph{keṭṭuhōgu}.) Repair work? (\textbf{\kn{ರಿಪೇರಿ}}, \emph{ripēri}.) A lorry? (\textbf{\kn{ಲಾರಿ}}, \emph{lāri}.) A jeep? (\textbf{\kn{ಜೀಪು}}, \emph{jīpu}.) A taxi? (\textbf{\kn{ಟ್ಯಾಕ್ಸಿ}}, \emph{ṭyāksi}.) A motorbike? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೈಕ್}}, \emph{baik}.) A bullock cart? (\textbf{\kn{ಎತ್ತಿನಗಾಡಿ}}, \emph{ettinagāḍi}.) Transport? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಾರಿಗೆ}}, \emph{sārige}.) A depot? (\textbf{\kn{ಡಿಪೋ}}, \emph{ḍipō}.) Goods? (\textbf{\kn{ಸರಕು}}, \emph{saraku}.) To transport? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಗಿಸು}}, \emph{sāgisu}.) A courier? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೊರಿಯರ್}}, \emph{koriyar}.) A ship? (\textbf{\kn{ಹಡಗು}}, \emph{haḍagu}.) A sailor? (\textbf{\kn{ನಾವಿಕ}}, \emph{nāvika}.) An anchor? (\textbf{\kn{ಲಂಗರು}}, \emph{laṅgaru}.) A compass? (\textbf{\kn{ದಿಕ್ಸೂಚಿ}}, \emph{diksūci}.) An ocean? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಗರ}}, \emph{sāgara}.) A coracle? (\textbf{\kn{ತೆಪ್ಪ}}, \emph{teppa}.) A ferryman? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಂಬಿಗ}}, \emph{ambiga}.) A shore? (\textbf{\kn{ತೀರ}}, \emph{tīra}.) High tide? (\textbf{\kn{ಉಬ್ಬರ}}, \emph{ubbara}.) A whirlpool? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುಳಿ}}, \emph{suḷi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
